description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.01 USDC per call via x402] Line totals (qty x unit price, minus line discounts), subtotal, invoice discount (spread over the lines by value), tax per invoice or per line (the usual source of 1-cent differences: both are shown), shipping (taxable or not) and the total, in exact decimals rounded to cents only where an invoice rounds. Pass the figures written on an invoice in claimed (and claimedTotal per line) and each comes back correct or wrong with the right value. You choose the rates; not tax advice.

claimed.description: figures written on the invoice, to check

discountPercent.description: invoice-level discount in percent, before tax

claimedTotal.description: the line total written on the invoice, to check

qty.description: quantity as a decimal string, e.g. "3" or "1.5"

taxRatePercent.description: this line's tax rate if it differs from the invoice rate

scale.description: decimal places of the currency, default 2

taxRounding.description: round tax once on the invoice (default) or on each line and add up

name: invoice_check
title: Compute or check an invoice exactly (lines, discounts, tax, shipping, total)
